crew_utilisation.label: Share of worker time spent handling freight

waiting_share.label: Share of worker time spent waiting

belt_idle_share.label: Share of staffed time with no hands at the belt

belt_contacts.label: Hand-to-belt contacts (estimated picks from the belt)

belt_contacts_per_min.label: Estimated picks from the belt per staffed minute

avg_crew.label: Average workers in view while staffed

peak_crew.label: Most workers in view at once

staffed_seconds.label: Seconds with at least one worker in view

avg_belt_occupancy.label: Average share of the visible belt covered by freight

belt_empty_share.label: Share of staffed time with the belt (nearly) empty and running

belt_stopped_seconds.label: Time the belt stood still with freight on it

belt_stopped_share.label: Share of the clip the belt stood still with freight on it

waiting_ws_belt_stopped.label: Waiting while the belt stood still

waiting_ws_belt_empty.label: Waiting at an empty, running belt

waiting_ws_freight_available.label: Waiting while freight was moving on the belt

line_flowing_share.label: Share of staffed time with freight moving on the belt

crew_level.label: Crew size at which the number of people working stops rising

spare_worker_seconds.label: Worker time above the crew size the line could use
